suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking
suggestion.rationale: Developers continually confuse I/O-bound concurrency with CPU-bound parallelism, leading to broken server architectures. This short breaks down when to use event loops versus system threads using clear mental models.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using threads for I/O-bound tasks until you understand what the Python Global Interpreter Lock is actually doing to your runtime performance.
